summary: INT. BASTION SPIRE — RELIC COURT — DAY. Bright stone.

dialogueInline.speaker: Admiral Cael Dominion
dialogueInline.text: The ceasefire held at the Auric Gate. We are here to end it—cleanly—or turn it into law.

dialogueInline.text: End it and you end us.
